system.description: A massive combat between two large groups of armed combatants.
system.notes:
Standard | Event

A massive combat between two large groups of armed combatants.
Impulses: Seize land and wealth, spill blood for greed and glory

Difficulty: 15

Features

Adrift on a Sea of Steel - Passive: Traversing a battlefield during an active combat requires a successful Finesse Roll to move at all, and PCs can only go up to Close range on a success. If an adversary is within Melee of them, they must mark a Stress to make the roll.

Raze and Pillage- Action: The attacking force raises the stakes by lighting a fire, stealing a valuable asset, kidnapping an important person, or killing the populace.

Cannon Volley - Action: Spend a Fear as the enemy battery fires a coordinated broadside. Pick a point on the battlefield within Very Far range. All targets within Close range of it must make a Finesse Reaction Roll. On a failure, they take 2d10 physical damage from the blast and shrapnel and must mark a Stress.

Reinforcements - Action: Summon a Veteran Knight, a number of appropriate Minions equal to the number of PCs, and two adversaries of your choice within Far range of a chosen PC as reinforcements. The Knight immediately takes the spotlight.
